parameters.query: SELECT patient_id, civilite, prenom, nom, to_char(date_naissance, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS naissance, chambre, etage, diagnostics, allergies, regime, risques FROM soins.residents WHERE patient_id = $1
SELECT patient_id, nom, chambre FROM soins.residents WHERE patient_id <> $1
SELECT id, horodatage, auteur, categorie, texte FROM soins.notes_soins WHERE patient_id = $1 AND horodatage >= $2::timestamptz AND horodatage <= $3::timestamptz ORDER BY horodatage
SELECT horodatage, type, valeur, unite FROM soins.signes_vitaux WHERE patient_id = $1 AND horodatage >= $2::timestamptz AND horodatage <= $3::timestamptz ORDER BY horodatage
SELECT medicament, dosage, schema_prise, indication FROM soins.plan_medication WHERE patient_id = $1 AND actif ORDER BY id
